methods.description: Identify equal groups and multiply group count by group size, using known partitioning/factorising strategies.
Treat equal rows as groups and multiply rows by items in each row.
Multiply a fixed daily amount by the number of days.
Find one grouped total then multiply by the amount in each smaller group.
Select quantities belonging to the requested total and leave unrelated empty groups out.
Represent a multiple of an amount and add the original amount when a combined total is asked for.
